entries.subject: feat(position_monitor): broaden Fix 1 MFE-lock to static stop-loss protection
entries.body:
The first live MFE case (BILL/USD at 14:48) revealed that Fix 1 v1 missed
profit-lock opportunities purely because the protection order was a
`stop-loss` (static) rather than `trailing-stop`. The +100 bps MFE shadow
fired but no amend ran. Post-deploy mix is ~60 % trailing-stop / 40 %
static stop-loss, so ~40 % of qualifying positions were silently outside
Fix 1's scope.

Broadens the MFE-driven breakeven-lock to act on **both** protection
order types using the same trigger criterion (`pullback` cohort, MFE >=
TRIGGER_BPS in side direction):

- `trailing-stop` (unchanged): tighten distance via
  `amend_trailing_stop_trigger_pct(new_trail_bps = pnl - offset)` only
  when `new_trail < active_trail` (capital protection invariant).
- `stop-loss` (new):  move the static trigger to
  `entry × (1 ± offset_bps/10000)` via `amend_stop_loss_trigger`, only
  when this moves the trigger in the profit-protective direction
  (long: above current SL; short: below current SL with > 0 guard).

Single shared funnel event `MFE_BREAKEVEN_LOCK_FIRED` with a
`protection_type` field in detail JSON to distinguish the two paths.

Capital invariant preserved: amends never widen, only tighten or shift
into the profit-protective direction.

Cohort scope is unchanged (pullback only); liquidity tier still v2.

EXISTS, but sqlx::migrate! wraps each migration in a transaction and
non-CONCURRENTLY index builds starve live INSERTs on the hot CDV /
edgeboard tables (observed: 5+ minute stalls; auto-retry on every
service restart compounded the problem).

Migrations now only ALTER columns + COMMENTs (idempotent). The matching
indexes are documented in the migration body and must be built via
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY post-deploy when write load allows.

entries.subject: fix(infra): structurele slice — dual L2 sampler + stale order pinning
entries.body:
B — dual L2 sampler bug (l2_feed.rs)
  - Outer run_l2_feed task abort liet inner reader/sampler tasks orphaned
    achter (JoinHandle::abort propageert niet naar inner spawn). Resultaat:
    twee parallelle L2_SAMPLER_HEARTBEAT met dezelfde run_id na elke
    universe rotation → INGEST_LINEAGE_CHANGED → execution NoNewEntries.
  - Wrap reader/sampler JoinHandle in nieuwe AbortOnDrop guard. Drop op
    cancellation (outer abort, future drop) aborteert het inner task
    deterministisch. Geen sibling-leak meer.

C — stale execution_orders pinning (db/read/universe_queries.rs)
  - pinned_symbols_from_open_orders sloot 'cancel_requested' niet uit en
    had geen tijdsbegrenzing. Eén ghost-row (SPC/USD 7d oud) hield het
    universe op pinned_count=1.
  - Voeg 'cancel_requested' toe aan exclusielijst en clamp pinning op
    rows met created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' als
    defense-in-depth. Legitieme entry-orders TTL'en in minuten;
    protection-orders worden via pinned_symbols_from_positions gepind.

Risico: laag. Beide changes versmallen alleen pinning/oprdracht-lifecycle,
geen safety-invariant geraakt. Rollback: git revert.

entries.subject: fix(live_runner): bind to ingest lineage in split-mode (Bug D)
entries.body:
Probleem
  prepare_live_startup_context riep onvoorwaardelijk
  ingest_epoch::create_lineage(ingest_pool) aan, ook wanneer een aparte
  krakenbot-ingest service al een lineage row heeft gecreëerd. Resultaat:
  twee rijen in krakenbot.ingest_lineage per startup. current_lineage_id
  (ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) selecteert dan een ID die NIET overeenkomt
  met de epochs die ingest blijft schrijven onder zijn eigen lineage_id.
  Elke evaluation cycle ziet execution: previous_lineage != current_lineage
  -> EXECUTION_INGEST_LINEAGE_BREAK -> LINEAGE_BREAK_GRACE NoNewEntries.

Fix
  Detecteer of ingest fresh data levert (current_valid_epoch_id < drempel).
  Zo ja: bind aan bestaande ingest-lineage via current_lineage_id().
  Zo nee: gedraag als monolith en maak zelf een lineage (bestaand gedrag).
  LIVE_USE_OWN_RUN_ONLY=true forceert altijd self-created (idem aan
  bestaande logica voor ingest_provides_data).

Risico: laag. Read-only check op ingest_pool.ingest_lineage; alleen
lineage-acquisitie verandert. Geen safety-invariant geraakt; rollback via
git revert.

controlled probe-quota analogous to EXPANSION_GATE_LIVE: 1-in-N (default

no live data to falsify the loss-cohort assumption. Probe-quota restores
controlled flow without re-opening the cohort widely.

- B2/B3/C1/C2 unchanged (still hard cuts)
- Capital protection / exposure / safety-state untouched

entries.subject: breakout-v2: shadow-only doctrine slice (default live OFF)
entries.body:
Dominant failure (audit 7d, 5350 resolved shadows): backward-looking activation.
expansion_score has zero correlation with outcome at any threshold; 0/5350 hit
±70 bps TP or ±35 bps SL within horizon. The detector fires post-impulse on
already-consumed expansion; forward 60-600s distribution is consolidation.

This slice ships a coherent breakout-v2 doctrine that is shadow-only:
- new module src/route_engine/breakout_v2.rs documenting entry/exit/execution/
  telemetry doctrine with env-tunable knobs (BREAKOUT_V2_*).
- v2 entry filter: route_type=breakout_continuation AND horizon ∈ {h10m,h15m}
  AND liq_tier ∈ {MID,HIGH} AND expansion_score ≥ 0.70 AND expected_move ≤ 200
  bps. Rejects the cohorts that produced 0% resolution in v1.
- v2 exit doctrine: TP=+50, SL=-25 (vs v1 hardcoded 70/35) — same RR but
  smaller absolute distances tighten the post-confirmation distribution match.
- shadow-only emission: alongside the existing v1 shadow row, qualifying breakout
  candidates get a parallel "breakout_v2_continuation/{horizon}" row with v2
  TP/SL so v1-vs-v2 outcome rates can be compared side-by-side over 3-7 days.
- new funnel events: BREAKOUT_V2_SHADOW_EMITTED (qualified) and
  BREAKOUT_V2_REJECTED with sub_reason (low_expansion / wrong_horizon /
  low_liquidity / predicted_move_too_large / wrong_route_type).

Live path: NO active live emission in this slice. admit_gate_v2 C1 still hard-
blocks the entire breakout family from reaching the exchange. BREAKOUT_V2_LIVE_
ENABLE flag is reserved for a future enable-slice contingent on shadow data.

Compliance invariants preserved: capital protection, exposure caps, balance
gates, safety-state, exit-protection state machine, DB-first truth — all
untouched. v2 writes only to krakenbot.shadow_trades and trading_funnel_events.

entries.subject: profit-taking: stagnation-aware harvest action (env-tunable, single-shot)
entries.body:
Adds LifecycleAction::HarvestProfit + env-tunable thresholds in
position_state_machine, wired into position_monitor between capital
protection (panic / hard-loss / time-stop / stale / regime-shift-loss)
and passive trail/tighten paths. Pullback skipped until MFE_BREAKEVEN_LOCK
fires; harvest then escalates if peak runs further and gives back.

Trigger (single-shot, market exit):
- peak_pnl_bps >= HARVEST_PEAK_FLOOR_BPS (default 60)
- pnl_bps >= HARVEST_MIN_OPEN_BPS (default 30)
- AND (giveback: pnl_bps <= peak_pnl_bps * HARVEST_GIVEBACK_RATIO,
        default 0.5) OR (drift stagnation: |drift_bps_per_min_1m| <
        HARVEST_DRIFT_STAGNATION_BPS_PER_MIN, default 0.3).

Funnel: emits HARVEST_PROFIT_FIRED on DECISION with peak/pnl/reason/cohort
fields for forensics. Rollback: HARVEST_PROFIT_ENABLE=false on server .env.
